customer.headline: Need help? Find a local person who can do the job.
customer.body: Browse local Service Providers by service, area, availability, experience, pricing information, portfolio and verified credentials where available.

provider.headline: Have a useful skill? Let local people find you.
provider.body: Create a Service Provider profile, show what you can do, add experience or portfolio evidence and receive service requests for tasks you are eligible to offer.

experienceFirst.headline: You can start before you have a long work history.
experienceFirst.body: Not every local service requires a formal qualification. For unrestricted tasks, beginners and experience-first providers can build a profile with skills, work history, portfolio examples and availability.
experienceFirst.transparency: Your profile must clearly show whether credentials are verified, unverified, experience-only or not on file.
experienceFirst.restriction: Credential-gated or regulated categories remain unavailable until required evidence and approval are complete.
allowedPhrases: Receive service requests for eligible tasks
Not every service requires a formal qualification

customerJourney: Review provider experience, credentials, portfolio, availability and price information
providerJourney: Create or apply for Service Provider profile
Add qualifications or credential evidence where relevant
Set service area, availability and pricing model
Build verified job history and reviews
categoryRule: Categories are data-driven. Some tasks may be unrestricted; others may require verified credentials or platform approval according to category and jurisdiction rules.

referral.shortCustomerShare: Need a local person for a job? Business & Life Local Services lets you browse Service Providers and request work. {REFERRAL_URL}
referral.shortProviderShare: Have a practical skill or trade? Business & Life lets eligible local Service Providers show skills, portfolio and availability and receive work requests. {REFERRAL_URL}
referral.beginnerShare: Starting out? For unrestricted tasks, you can build a Local Services profile around your skills, experience and portfolio — formal qualifications are not required for every service. {REFERRAL_URL}
